name: Stock Data Archive
description: Discover historical US stock and ETF coverage, including delisted tickers, inspect Parquet/CSV schemas and public sample download URLs, and list dataset products. Public discovery is free and read-only. Purchased file listings require the buyer's bearer API token. The server returns metadata and download URLs; market data is loaded from the files, not streamed through MCP.
